name: Hemophilia
body:
School necromancy; Level sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (drop of cobra venom)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell causes the blood of the victim to thin and prevents blood clotting. Any wounds sustained by the subject during the spell’s duration from slashing or piercing weapon attacks cause an additional 1 point of Constitution damage per blow. Living creatures that do not have blood are immune to the effects of this spell.
